## Question

How does the sample paper index distribute citations across years and topics?

The input is `../../research-irene/data/papers.csv`. The Research project owns
that file; this study reads it and records its SHA-256 in the generated report.

```{python}
import csv
from collections import Counter
from pathlib import Path

input_path = Path("../../research-irene/data/papers.csv")
rows = list(csv.DictReader(input_path.open()))
year_totals = Counter(row["year"] for row in rows)
topic_totals = Counter(row["topic"] for row in rows)
year_totals, topic_totals
```

The checked-in companion report and figure are generated by
`../bin/analyze.py`, so the same calculation can run without a Quarto install.
